lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a quasi-rectangular grid, with the most prominent nodes forming vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of white spots intersect with horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like pattern of high-luminance anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible across the posterior and central surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible attached to or swimming in close proximity to the ventral side of the shark, particularly near the pectoral fin.
